# Frontier reset: scientific checkpoint, 7 October2026

The strongest research-enabling advance is a smaller explicit detector and exact learner for finite-state noncommutative algebraic models. The strongest separate foundational lead is a threshold-repetition theorem for arbitrary commuting-operator strategies. Both have complete written derivations and multiple internal reconstructions. Neither has external validation, compiled formal verification or established historical novelty. No revolutionary breakthrough is claimed.

## 1. Exact representation acquisition

For n symbols and a proper characteristic-zero recognizable series with at most m hidden states, let T_i be the explicit Volterra matrices of dimension2nm. Our new theorem is

    f !=0  implies  f(ell T_1,...,ell T_n)!=0
    for some integer ell in {1,...,m}.

All evaluations exist because the matrices are jointly strictly lower triangular. This is a universal deterministic hitting set whose construction reads only n,m. One direct-sum tuple has dimension2nm². The prior construction in this cycle used a length marker of dimension approximately n²m⁴. For acyclic representations, one unscaled tuple of dimension2nm already suffices when its full matrix output is read.

The proof uses the released finite-word hyperlogarithm independence, but replaces its scalar multiplicity argument with a bivariate Volterra kernel. A covariant rational row-span argument finds a nonzero diagonal derivative before order m. Degree bounds and Cauchy interpolation make it visible in dimension2nm. A new scalar-parameter degree bound then reduces cyclic faithfulness to m fixed rescalings. This last step was derived by root and independently reconstructed by four workers. Root also reconstructed the complete primary monodromy proof of finite-word independence.

The boundary is equally concrete. The nonzero proper series

    AB-B(I+A)^-1A(I+B)

has leading commutator AB-BA, yet vanishes on the unscaled Volterra operators J_1,J_2 on EVERY formal input, and hence at every finite truncation. Increasing the matrix size cannot repair that cyclic alias. Scalar grading supplies the missing information.

Status, 7 October 2026: an independently reconstructed mathematical transfer,
not an executed Lean theorem or an external validation. The source result is
OpenAI, *An Upper Bound of 9/4 for the Matrix Multiplication Exponent*, dated
2 October 2026, Theorem 1.1. The pinned source proves the complex-field result.
This note supplies the characteristic-sensitive steps needed to carry the same
argument over a fixed finite field. A peer is separately checking the transfer.

Pinned source: `adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a`,
`preprints/Matrix-Multiplication-Nine-Fourths-October-2-2026/build/paper.tex`.
The complete manuscript, including Appendix A, was read. Exact source labels:
`prop:separation`, `cor:entropy`, `lem:interpolation`, `lem:concavity`,
`lem:tripling`, `lem:growth`, and `lem:existence`. The source's later
number-field remark already addresses characteristic-zero coefficient descent.

## 1. Interface and the one descent lemma

Fix a finite field F of size q. All tensors, restrictions, direct sums, tensor
products, and characters below are over F. A character is a normalized,
nonnegative, additive, multiplicative, restriction-monotone map. A restriction
is a coefficient identity, not equality merely as functions on a finite set.

Let E/F be a finite extension of degree k, and let ell:E -> F be an F-linear
map with ell(1)=1. Such a map exists by choosing a basis containing 1. For
three E-valued F-linear forms U,V,W, write their coordinate expansions in an
F-basis e_1,...,e_k. Then

    ell(U V W) = sum_(i,j,h) ell(e_i e_j e_h) U_i V_j W_h.

Consequently, if an E-linear restriction of the base extension A_E has all
its final coefficients in F, its result is an F-linear restriction of at
most k^3 full copies of A. Each summand uses a WHOLE A copy: its maps on
each leg are the coordinate forms of the respective E-valued substitution,
and the scalar ell(e_i e_j e_h) is absorbed into one leg. The coefficients
of A lie in F and therefore pass through ell. The statement also holds
coefficientwise for Laurent-polynomial substitutions in a formal parameter.

The projection is not treated as a field homomorphism. The displayed cubic
expansion is essential. Merely applying ell separately to U,V,W would be
false.

# Finite-extension descent for trilinear degenerations

7 October 2026. Root derivation. Status: elementary transfer lemma independently reconstructed. The application now passes the scoped manual gate below; it remains dependent on the released proof and has no external or compiled formal validation.

Let F⊆E be a degree-k field extension, and let A be a trilinear tensor over F. Suppose a restriction or Laurent-polynomial degeneration of L copies of A over E has leading tensor B defined over F. Choose an F-linear functional ell:E→F with ell(1)=1. Expand each of the three leg maps in a fixed F-basis e_1,...,e_k of E. Applying ell to all scalar coefficients of the resulting trilinear form gives a sum of at most Lk³ restrictions of A over F: the coefficient of the (a,b,c) term is ell(e_a e_b e_c), which is absorbed into one leg map.

Coefficient projection preserves every vanishing lower Laurent coefficient and fixes B. Consequently

    A^(direct sum Lk³) degenerates over F to B.

This argument applies coefficient by coefficient and does not require ell to be multiplicative. Treating ell as multiplicative would be an error; the k³ expansion is exactly the cost of avoiding it. All coefficients and exponents of the original finite maps remain represented explicitly if they were explicitly supplied. This is an algebraic statement, not an assertion that an existential rank decomposition can be cheaply acquired.

For a Fourier separator with M labels over F_q, choose k so that L=q^k−1>3(M−1). Then k=O_q(log M), L=O_q(M), and E=F_(q^k) contains a primitive Lth root; L is invertible in E. Character orthogonality works exactly in E. Integer exponents of a formal degeneration parameter are integer valuations, not elements reduced modulo the characteristic. If the separator uses only these facts, descent costs O_q(M log³ M) source copies. For M exponential in tensor power, the polynomial-in-power factor has zero asymptotic entropy cost.
